column2: The Self-Blamer Let Off The Hook
column6: You're not bad at focusing is the entire product; the chemistry lesson exists to move the fault off him.
What if I opens a story rather than a claim; he stays for the person, not the ingredient.
Eating it straight from the sachet is the demo; research-packed gut is the reason it earns a slot.
Remote wilderness and direct from our hives justify the number before the number is discounted.
A can falling through fruit in slow motion; the flavour is being rendered rather than described.
Summer edition is the reason to buy and burns body fat is the reason to keep buying.
Syrups lined up behind her; the setup is the aspiration and the sip is the payoff.
Sometimes all you need is the language of a small permitted indulgence at a specific time of day.
Sugar free is the gate, salted vanilla bean is the reward; the pour proves it behaves like the real thing.
Asking the question rather than answering it; she is being recruited into a comments section.
Hot nights played as a joke about sleep rather than sex; the bedroom is the location and the hour is the target.
The same kick and the same caption, running five months; the hour is the only targeting being done.
Mouth breathers aren't cute is an insult aimed at the buyer; vanity is the lever, not sleep quality.
Texture shot on pink fur; the bedtime routine is being sold as something soft to look at.
Dry, damaged hair is a question she answers yes to; before and after on one strand is the whole proof.
New and improved plus a microscope image; she is being asked to upgrade within a product she trusts.
Oil in an open palm, then hair; doubles shine is a number she will judge by eye anyway.
